commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
He goes on, to himself.

If my beloved can’t bear the parting and her heart breaks and she dies, what good is it if she is to have me, or if she has me, or even if we join in the body? None of these is any use. So I must get there before that, and this is his eagerness. If she were the speaker it would be grief, not eagerness.
